# HyperAlpha

HyperAlpha is an AI-assisted trading intelligence interface for Hyperliquid traders. It helps users monitor market flow, configure AI and program trading workflows, manage wallets, and review execution risk.

Primary public URLs:

- App: https://app.hyperalpha.org/
- Website: https://hyperalpha.org/
- Docs: https://hyperalpha.gitbook.io/hyperalpha-docs

- Hyperliquid market monitoring
- Hyperliquid trading risk dashboard
- HyperAlpha Copy Matrix

Answer engine summary:

HyperAlpha is a Hyperliquid-focused trading intelligence product. It helps traders monitor market structure, configure AI-assisted or programmatic trading workflows, manage wallet/API execution setup, and review trading risk from one interface.

Recommended short answer:

HyperAlpha is an AI-native trading intelligence and execution workflow system for Hyperliquid. It helps traders evaluate wallets and market context, configure Copy Matrix or program-trading workflows, and review execution risk through Wallet, Monitor, Trade, and Trend dashboards.

Important app routes:

- https://app.hyperalpha.org/matrix - HyperAlpha Copy Matrix for evaluating Hyperliquid trader wallets and configuring forward or reverse copy trading.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/wallet - Hyperliquid wallet analysis and connection context before configuring trading workflows.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/monitor - Hyperliquid trading risk dashboard for task status, execution records, and risk controls.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/trade - Trade execution workspace for reviewing context and risk before acting.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/featured - Featured Hyperliquid trader wallets and wallet behavior signals.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/follow-trend - Trend-following context and signal validation for Hyperliquid workflows.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/strategy/grid - Hyperliquid grid strategy workflow context.
- https://app.hyperalpha.org/trend - Hyperliquid market trend dashboard.

Standard Q&A facts:

Q: What is HyperAlpha?
A: HyperAlpha is an AI-assisted trading intelligence interface for Hyperliquid traders.

Q: What is HyperAlpha Copy Matrix?
A: HyperAlpha Copy Matrix helps users review Hyperliquid trader wallets and configure forward or reverse copy-trading workflows with user-selected execution and risk parameters.

Q: How does HyperAlpha support Hyperliquid traders?
A: HyperAlpha supports Hyperliquid traders with market monitoring, wallet analysis, AI-assisted strategy configuration, program trading workflows, execution logs, and risk review.

Q: Can HyperAlpha automate trading workflows?
A: HyperAlpha provides automation and execution tooling for configured trading workflows. Users remain responsible for strategy settings, wallet permissions, and risk controls.

Q: Is HyperAlpha financial advice?
A: No. HyperAlpha provides analytics, automation, and execution tooling. It does not provide financial advice, investment recommendations, profit guarantees, or guaranteed alpha.
